timeline.summary: On April 30, 2026, Sambhv Steel Tubes announced a temporary 15-day maintenance closure of select power, kiln, and furnace facilities at its Raipur plant starting May 1, 2026.
On May 9, 2026, Sambhv Steel Tubes said AVP - CEO's Office & Investor Relations Mayank Agrawal resigned to pursue professional growth, effective May 31, 2026.
On May 9, 2026, Sambhv Steel Tubes submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing ₹1.93 Cr utilized during the quarter.

On May 10, 2026, Sambhv Steel Tubes' Q4FY26 investor presentation reported FY26 revenue up 60% to ₹2,413.20 Cr and PAT up 147% to ₹143.30 Cr, and set out a plan to grow finished-product capacity from 0.62 to 2.03 MMTPA, with Phase-I 0.36 MMTPA stainless steel coils targeted for Q4FY27.
Niraj Shrivastava shared the audio recording link for Sambhv Steel Tubes Limited’s May 11, 2026, investor conference call on Q4 FY26 results.
On May 15, 2026, Sambhv Steel Tubes submitted the transcript of its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call held on May 11, 2026.
On May 19, 2026, Sambhv Steel Tubes announced the receipt of amended CTO for expanding Cold Rolling Mill capacity to 1,16,000 MTPA.
On May 19, 2026, Sambhv Steel Tubes announced the receipt of Consent to Establish for a 1,18,000 MTPA stainless steel cold rolling mill at Kuthrel Unit-II.
Sambhv Steel Tubes allotted 86.95 lakh fully convertible equity warrants raising ₹25 Cr upfront.
Sambhv Steel Tubes approved a ₹148 Cr greenfield project for stainless steel seamless pipes and reported in Q2 PAT.
Niraj Shrivastava shared the audio recording link for the October 30, 2026, conference call discussing unaudited Q2FY27 results.
